items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: So you never played with Alexander Pope? No, I never played on him. But when he was in the band, he played for my father's funeral.

ctx.x: Can you remember when Mr. Pope, Alexander Pope played, did he play the E-flat or the B-flat when you were in the band?

Oh, Alexander Pope, he wasn't in the band. He would take jobs for the band. He didn't play it? Alexander, he had done quit the band and his son had taken it over. Johnny had taken it over. So you never played with Alexander Pope? No, I never played on him. But when he was in the band, he played for my father's funeral. And my father died when I was about eight years old. And he was my father. And the old cruel society called, let's see, what was the name of that society? He was the first member they lost. And the…
Oh yes, I wanted to ask a little bit more about the funerals. Did they play slow numbers for the funeral marches or hymns or what kind of music did they use?
